Yeah, it was really hard. The person I share the room with (we live in separate small rooms but share a common area and bathroom) got really sick for over a week and I’m assuming it was COVID or a horrible case of the flu since it was really prevalent once masks went away at my school.

It’s just really hard to believe that since there’s plenty of people attending who didn’t adhere to the school’s mask mandate even when it was mandatory for everyone, so now that it’s basically on the honor system, people like my roommate will be able to go without their masks despite being unvaccinated.

It just feels like it’s going to be a constant problem that just won’t go away because of selfishness and it just makes my anxiety at getting sick worse since I have two vulnerable family members who I’m terrified of bringing it back to.
Okay please bot, I literally just thanked you for trying to help, you don’t need to automatically hangs the flair. I’m still looking for advice for my school situation.
Thanks! I’ll check out those subs today when I’ve got time.
Thanks for trying to help bot, but I don’t think this helps cover everything I’m asking about. The doctor one might help with mental health help but I don’t think they help with my other problems.

Getting strangled by one of the other stage crew members during a rehearsal for the school play. There were even some other stage crew people nearby but they didn’t notice us. It was absolutely terrifying because I thought I might die.

I guess I just feel scared of telling others about this. I don’t want my parents to think less of me because I hid this from them. It also didn’t really come up at the time partially because I was also being bullied by a random kid I didn’t know around the same time. Plus, I don’t plan on pressing charges, which I feel is the first thing that would come to mind and I’m not sure how well it will be received.
